Description
Beautifully updated, unfurnished 2-story townhouse-style condo in sought-after Kitsilano. This bright, south-facing home features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a spacious laundry room and ample storage. Modern kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, gas stove and plenty of cabinetry. Open-concept living and dining area with a cozy gas fireplace. Enjoy a private, south-facing fenced yard and patio, perfect for outdoor dining and relaxing. Building amenities include a children's playroom, bike room and workshop. Steps to transit and close to UBC, Downtown, Bayview Elementary, parks, shops, cafes and restaurants.

Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Welcome to this exceptional Net-Zero front half-duplex in Point Grey, designed by Marrimor Interiors & built by True Maple Construction. Defined by high-performance sustainability & bespoke craft, the sun-lit main floor features a chef’s kitchen with integrated Miele appliances, custom millwork, & an oversized island. Upstairs, 3 bedrooms each enjoy a private ensuite with radiant in-floor heating, highlighted by a serene primary suite with a spa-inspired bath & WIC. The top level opens to a private balcony framing North Shore mountain & skyline views. Complete with 4 baths, central A/C, crawl space storage, & an EV garage. Steps from W 10th shops, cafes, top schools, UBC, Jericho Beach & Spanish Banks. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.

Garden level offers self-contained suite w/ kitchenette, ideal for in-law, caregiver or visiting family. Extensive outdoor spaces incl. patio & deck w/ direct water access, beautifully landscaped private yard. Pets upon approval.
